concerns.text: The functional requirement FR-001 (and several others) refer to “(See US-1)”, “(See US-2)”, “(See US-3)”. No identifiers named US‑1/US‑2/US‑3 exist in the document; the user stories are labeled “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, etc. This broken cross‑reference makes traceability impossible.

The document mixes two naming conventions for user stories – the narrative headings use “User Story 1” while the FRs use the shorthand “US‑1”. Without a clear mapping, readers cannot determine which story each FR is tied to, causing a silent scope shift.
